root_cause: Full-rewrite detection required a specific TARGET_FILE marker at the start of the editor's response. When the editor omitted the marker but still emitted a complete file, the response fell through to a strict SEARCH/REPLACE parser and was rejected, looping the pipeline.

details.rule: Detection heuristics that gate a fallback mode must be permissive, not strict. When ambiguous, prefer the fallback. A missed detection silently breaks the pipeline; a false positive only costs one extra validation pass.
